verses.ar: أَبْتَدِئُ الْإِمْلَاءَ بِاسْمِ الذَّاتِ الْعَلِيَّةْ ۞ مُسْتَدِرًّا فَيْضَ الْبَرَكَاتِ عَلٰى مَا أَنَالَهُ وَأَوْلَاهْ ۞ وَأُثَنِّي بِحَمْدٍ مَوَارِدُهُ سَائِغَةٌ هَنِيَّةْ ۞ مُمْتَطِيًا مِنَ الشُّكْرِ الْجَمِيلِ مَطَايَاهْ ۞ وَأُصَلِّي وَأُسَلِّمُ عَلٰى النُّورِ الْمَوْصُوفِ بِالتَّقَدُّمِ وَالْأَوَّلِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Abtadi'u l-imlā'a bi-smi dh-dhāti l-ʿaliyyah, mustadirran fayḍa l-barakāti ʿalā mā anālahu wa-awlāh, wa-uthannī bi-ḥamdin mawāriduhu sā'ighatun haniyyah, mumtaṭiyan mina sh-shukri l-jamīli maṭāyāh, wa-uṣallī wa-usallimu ʿalā n-nūri l-mawṣūfi bi-t-taqaddumi wa-l-awwaliyyah.
verses.en: I begin this composition in the Name of the Most Exalted Essence, seeking the abundant outpouring of blessings through what He has bestowed and graciously conferred. I follow this with praise whose streams are sweet and pleasant to drink, mounting the steeds of beautiful gratitude. And I send prayers and peace upon the Light described by precedence and primacy.

verses.ar: الْمُنْتَقِلِ فِي الْغُرَرِ الْكَرِيمَةِ وَالْجِبَاهْ ۞ وَأَسْتَمْنِحُ اللّٰهَ تَعَالَى رِضْوَانًا يَخُصُّ الْعِتْرَةَ الطَّاهِرَةَ النَّبَوِيَّةْ ۞ وَيَعُمُّ الصَّحَابَةَ وَالْأَتْبَاعَ وَمَنْ وَالَاهْ ۞ وَأَسْتَجْدِيهِ هِدَايَةً لِسُلُوكِ السُّبُلِ الْوَاضِحَةِ الْجَلِيَّةْ ۞ وَحِفْظًا مِنَ الْغَوَايَةِ فِي خِطَطِ الْخَطَإِ وَخُطَاهْ
verses.tr: Al-muntaqili fī l-ghurari l-karīmati wa-l-jibāh, wa-astamniḥu Llāha taʿālā riḍwānan yakhuṣṣu l-ʿitrata ṭ-ṭāhirata n-nabawiyyah, wa-yaʿummu ṣ-ṣaḥābata wa-l-atbāʿa wa-man wālāh, wa-astajdīhi hidāyatan li-sulūki s-subuli l-wāḍiḥati l-jaliyyah, wa-ḥifẓan mina l-ghawāyati fī khiṭaṭi l-khaṭa'i wa-khuṭāh.
verses.en: Who passed through noble countenances and radiant brows. I beseech Allah Most High for a special pleasure bestowed upon the pure Prophetic Household, and extended to all the Companions, the Followers, and those who are devoted to him. I implore Him for guidance to tread the clear and manifest paths, and for protection from straying into the ways and footsteps of error.

verses.ar: وَأَنْشُرُ مِنْ قِصَّةِ الْمَوْلِدِ النَّبَوِيِّ الشَّرِيفِ بُرُودًا حِسَانًا عَبْقَرِيَّةْ ۞ نَاظِمًا مِنَ النَّسَبِ الشَّرِيفِ عِقْدًا تُحَلَّى الْمَسَامِعُ بِحُلَاهْ ۞ وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِحَوْلِ اللّٰهِ تَعَالَى وَقُوَّتِهِ الْقَوِيَّةْ ۞ فَإِنَّهُ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهْ
verses.tr: Wa-anshuru min qiṣṣati l-mawlidi n-nabawiyyi sh-sharīfi burūdan ḥisānan ʿabqariyyah, nāẓiman mina n-nasabi sh-sharīfi ʿiqdan tuḥalla l-masāmiʿu bi-ḥulāh, wa-astaʿīnu bi-ḥawli Llāhi taʿālā wa-quwwatihi l-qawiyyah, fa-innahu lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāh.
verses.en: And I unfold from the account of the noble Prophetic birth splendid and exquisite robes, stringing from the noble lineage a necklace whose ornaments adorn the ears. I seek aid through the might of Allah Most High and His mighty power, for there is no might and no power except through Allah.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
